description:
O CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO está localizado na região central da cidade, no Bairro de Benfica. Os serviços prestados abrangem toda a população carioca, residente da cidade. É uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida.

A unidade de saúde é preparada para o atendimento às mais diversas patologias do universo oftalmológico para a população da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, tais como:

·diagnóstico e tratamento dos distúrbios da motilidade ocular, visão binocular e anomalias associadas;

·realização de exames para correção refrativa e adaptação de lentes de contacto, bem como para análise da função visual;

·avaliação da condução nervosa do estímulo visual e das deficiências do campo visual;

·programação e utilização de terapêuticas específicas de recuperação e reeducação das perturbações da visão binocular e de subvisão;

·ações de sensibilização, programas de rastreio e prevenção no âmbito da promoção e educação para a saúde.

·realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação.

Coordenar a fim de garantir o cumprimento de normas, rotinas, regulamentações da Instituição e, das atividades planejadas para assistência, participando, analisando e avaliando os processos e as interfaces com a equipe para promover uma assistência segura e de qualidade. Acompanhar, analisar e tratar os relatórios e atendimentos necessários para o cumprimento das metas, prazos e melhorias.

Realizar atividades na especialidade de oftalmologia, prevenir, diagnosticar e tratar das doenças e distúrbios dos olhos e visão, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal de Saúde.

Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina. Residência Médica, Título de Especialista em Oftalmologia, Registro de Qualificação de Especialidade (RQE);

Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;

Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada como Médico Oftalmologista;

Especialista em Segmento Posterior com comprovante de Estagio (Fellowship) em Retina.

  • Local de Trabalho: Benfica - RJ
  • Carga Horária: 12h semanais

  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.
  • Step 3: Avaliação Comportamental - Gestão de Pessoas 3 Avaliação Comportamental - Gestão de Pessoas

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow
description:
Join to apply for the Postdoctoral Research Fellow role at Inside Higher Ed

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Conduct NIH-funded research on RNA-based gene regulation in Staphylococcus aureus , a gram-positive bacterial pathogen prone to cause multi-drug-resistant bloodstream infections. The specific focus will be on small proteins, small RNAs, and tRNA modifications. The postdoctoral research fellow will lead experiments investigating RNA–RNA and RNA–protein interactions in bacterial stress adaptation and virulence.

Supervisory Authority

Dr. Karl M. Thompson, Ph.D. – Associate Professor and University Biosafety Officer

Nature And Scope

This is a lab-based research position in molecular microbiology. The Fellow will:

  • Perform functional studies of small protein and RNA function and interactions using a combination of molecular genetics (mutants, over-expression, gene-fusions, two-hybrid constructs); biochemical and biophysical tools (e.g., AUC, MST, SEC-MALS).
  • Conduct RNA stability assays, RIP-seq, and bacterial genetics.
  • Collaborate on in vivo studies and murine infection models.
  • Contribute to mentoring, manuscript writing, and data presentation.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Design and execute experiments on RNA regulators and stress-response pathways.
  • Analyze and interpret data from RNA-protein and RNA–RNA interaction assays.
  • Generate and characterize mutant bacterial strains.
  • Maintain detailed lab records and uphold research rigor.
  • Support manuscript and grant preparation.

Core Competencies

  • Strong background in molecular microbiology and RNA biology.
  • Experience with RNA-binding assays, RIP/qPCR/seq, and transcript stability analysis.
  • Familiarity with protein–RNA interaction techniques and bacterial genetics.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills.

Minimum Requirements

PhD in Microbiology, Biochemistry, or related field. Track record in RNA biology or microbial gene regulation. Hands-on experience with relevant molecular techniques. Prior S. aureus or Gram-positive pathogen work preferred.

Overview

When you think of InComm Payments, think of Innovative Payments Technology. We were founded over 30 years ago and continue to be a pioneer in the payment (FinTech) industry. Since our inception, we have grown to be a team of over 3,000 employees in 35 countries around the world. We own over 400 global technical patents and a network that includes over 525,000 points of retail distribution that points to our industry expertise.

We are significantly growing our Engineering and IT teams in Brazil and are focused on finding talent for various financial technology (Fintech) engineering, database, development, and testing teams.

InComm Payments is highly focused on our people and their growth, and we work hard to make a career at InComm Payments meaningful and rewarding. We value innovation, quality, passion, integrity and responsibility in all that we do, and we are looking for great people to join our team as we move forward towards a very bright future. We anticipate developing future leaders for our teams in Brazil!

Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses! All positions are CLT.

You can learn more about InComm Payments by visiting our Website or connecting with us on LinkedIn , YouTube , Twitter , Facebook , or Instagram .


About This Opportunity

Join our lean and dynamic NOC team as a NOC Technician, where you will play a key role in maintaining the operational excellence of our network. This position is ideal for someone with a basic understanding of networking concepts and a strong willingness to learn and grow in a fast-paced, 24/7/365 environment. As part of our team, you will be responsible for monitoring alerts, managing emails and tickets, and escalating issues to ensure continuous network performance.
Given the lean nature of our NOC, flexibility is crucial. While your primary schedule will be 9 AM to 6 PM US Eastern Time, Monday through Friday, you must be open to shift changes and occasional late-night deployments to support live monitoring of our network resources during those deployments.


Responsibilities
  • Monitor network alerts using tools such as Solar Winds, Thousand Eyes, Pingdom, or Splunk.
  • Respond to emails and manage tickets in ServiceNow ITSM.
  • Escalate issues to more experienced team members when necessary.
  • Participate in shift changes and late-night deployments as needed.
  • Collaborate with team members to ensure continuous network operations and quick resolution of incidents.

Qualifications
  • 1–2 years of experience in a networking or IT support role.
  • Basic understanding of networking concepts (e.g., TCP/IP, VPN, routing).
  • Familiarity with network monitoring tools and ticket management systems (ServiceNow experience is a plus).
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including nights and weekends as needed.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn.
  • Excellent communication skills for effective collaboration and knowledge sharing.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experi- ence preferred.
  • CCNA or other entry-level networking certifications are a plus.
  • Experience with AVI and F5 load balancers.
  • Familiarity with Cisco and Palo Alto network devices.
  • Knowledge of Itential automation tools and Ansible.
  • Experience with network monitoring tools such as Solar Winds, Thousand Eyes, Pingdom, or Splunk.

Overview

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Qualifications

  • Formação de acordo com a função exercida;
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovadas na área de atuação
  • Laudo médico válido e carimbado por médico especialista.

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with a Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences.

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).

description:

Você acredita que a educação melhora o mundo? Você quer participar de uma rede de networking de mais de 4 mil executivos e 1.000 estudantes onde, além de gerar valor para sua carreira, você também contribui para educação e combate à fome? Se a resposta é sim, venha conosco!

A PUC angels (Associação Anjos da PUC) é uma associação sem fins lucrativos que busca, por meio da educação, aprimorar o ecossistema de empreendedorismo e empregabilidade no Brasil. Acreditamos que o primeiro empreendimento de uma pessoa é sua carreira profissional. Hoje, contamos com mais de 20 colaboradores diretos e uma rede de mais de 4.000 executivos e 1.000 estudantes no Programa Anjo, que também pode incluir você – com oportunidades para atuar como mentor, executivo, empreendedor e/ou investidor.

Formato do Comitê de Saúde PUC angels

O cargo é voluntário e remoto, para atuar como Membro do Comitê de Saúde (com possibilidade de progressão para a posição de Líder Anjo de Saúde para empresas e startups interessadas). Os membros contribuem com o ecossistema da PUC angels, auxiliando fundadores de startups, executivos e estudantes no desenvolvimento e aplicação de conhecimentos, além de participar de iniciativas e comissões conforme a demanda. Os Líderes Anjo podem liderar as Iniciativas e Comissões, conforme submetem o tema e o mesmo é aprovado pelo Presidente do Comitê.

Papéis: Membro Executivo vs. Líder Anjo do Comitê de Saúde

Como Membro, você participa de reuniões gerais e abertas, assim como eventos, podendo sugerir temas para revisão, além de divulgar seu título de Membro do Comitê de em seu LinkedIn. Como Líder Anjo, terá a oportunidade de liderar Comissões e Iniciativas, assumir diretorias do comitê, submeter temas para avaliação da Presidência, e poderá concorrer à liderança do Comitê, participando de eventos exclusivos para Líder Anjos e outros associados.

Qualificações:

  • Interesse e paixão pelo tema do Comitê de Saúde
  • Capacidade de pensar estrategicamente e aplicar conhecimentos na prática
  • Paixão por contribuir para a sociedade por meio da educação
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento
  • Habilidade de trabalho remoto e proativo
  • Envolvimento com o tema do comitê
  • Proficiência em português (inglês e espanhol são diferenciais pois a PUC angels está expandindo)
  • Paciência e habilidade para ensinar e motivar

Por que Participar como Membro ou Líder Anjo no Comitê de Saúde da PUC angels?

  • Ganhe visibilidade no mercado, destacando-se como um Líder Anjo do Comitê de Saúde da PUC angels
  • Tenha impacto direto no ecossistema de inovação e mudanças de mercado, assumindo uma posição de liderança
  • Acrescente experiência e o título de Membro Executivo /Líder Anjo do Comitê de Saúde da PUC angels ao seu perfil profissional
  • Expanda seu networking com mais de 4.000 executivos, 1.000 alunos e empreendedores
  • Participe como mentor, conselheiro, investidor e/ou empreendedor dentro do ecossistema de networking da PUC angels
  • Escolha as frentes em que deseja atuar ou explore todas as oportunidades que oferecemos

Atividades do Comitê

  • Reuniões online: Sessões periódicas sobre temas de mercado e painéis com profissionais de destaque
  • Produção de artigos: Elaboração de conteúdos sobre novidades e dados de mercado
  • Regulamentações: Participação em grupos para regulamentação de iniciativas, com interação direta com executivos, empresas, governo e outras associações via PUC angels

Oportunidades Complementares

  • Possibilidade de investir em projetos já existentes
  • Sessões de pitch (online e presenciais), eventos de aceleração e parcerias estratégicas
  • Atuação como Mentor ou Conselheira Anjo para startups e estudantes

Networking e Eventos

  • Acesso a grupos exclusivos no WhatsApp e LinkedIn
  • Participação em eventos temáticos presenciais e online promovidos pela PUC angels e Comitês, em locais de destaque como a Tuca da PUC SP, Inovabra e FIEP

Objetivo dos Comitês PUC angels

Promover a evolução e integração dos mercados em que atua através do conhecimento e networking, atuando, quando necessário, na regulamentação necessária para que cada mercado cresça de forma sustentável.

Missão PUC angels

Melhorar o mundo através da educação e do combate à fome.

Objetivo do Comitê de Saúde PUC angels

Promover o empreendedorismo de Saúde, networking e inovação, fortalecendo empresas, ampliando a empregabilidade e gerando valor para todas as pessoas envolvidas.

Job description

O CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO está localizado na região central da cidade, no Bairro de Benfica. Os serviços prestados abrangem toda a população carioca, residente da cidade. Uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida.

A unidade de saúde está preparada para o atendimento às mais diversas patologias do universo oftalmológico para a população da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, tais como:

·diagnóstico e tratamento dos distúrbios da motilidade ocular, visão binocular e anomalias associadas;

·realização de exames para correção refrativa e adaptação de lentes de contacto, bem como para análise da função visual;

·avaliação da condução nervosa do estímulo visual e das deficiências do campo visual;

·programação e utilização de terapêuticas específicas de recuperação e reeducação das perturbações da visão binocular e de subvisão;

·ações de sensibilização, programas de rastreio e prevenção no âmbito da promoção e educação para a saúde.

·realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação.

Coordenar a fim de garantir o cumprimento de normas, rotinas, regulamentações da Instituição e, das atividades planejadas para assistência, participando, analisando e avaliando os processos e as interfaces com a equipe para promover uma assistência segura e de qualidade. Acompanhar, analisar e tratar os relatórios e atendimentos necessários para o cumprimento das metas, prazos e melhorias.


Main responsibilities

Realizar atividades na especialidade de oftalmologia, prevenir, diagnosticar e tratar das doenças e distúrbios dos olhos e visão, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal de Saúde.

Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina;

Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista em Oftalmologia;

Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;

Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada como Médico Oftalmologista;

Especialista em Oftalmopediatria com comprovante de Estagio (Fellowship) ou Carta de Serviço ou Especialista na Área.

One of the core values at VI is transparency. Therefore feel free to “try before you apply” by visiting our VI-P Guide , which includes our values, how we operate, how we build our packages, and a few other snippets of who we are!

Your Role

Join the fast-paced, rapidly expanding Placements Team at Virtual Internships, where we’re guaranteeing remote internships for students worldwide. As a Placement Matching Specialist, your mission is to match interns with global companies by using creativity, persuasion, and relentless drive.

Whether you’re already in an SDR, BDR, Sales Rep or recruitment role, or even looking for a career switch from another field, this is your chance to make a real impact in a rapidly growing team.

The role will start as a 3-month full-time contract role , with potential to become permanent dependent on performance.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Securing global opportunities by placing interns with innovative companies across industries and time zones.
  • Leading the conversation in virtual meetings to present our interns and highlight the value of our internship programs.
  • Building lasting partnerships by advising companies on intern selection and supporting them throughout the process.
  • Sourcing smart through LinkedIn, cold outreach, creative networking, and any method that gets results.
  • Keeping placements on track by managing key administrative steps to ensure a smooth and efficient process.
  • (P.S. The secret password is “moo ”—you’ll need it later!)

Why You'll Love This Role

  • Global Impact: You’ll work with interns from 100+ countries and companies from 75+ countries, expanding your cultural awareness and adaptability.
  • Endless Opportunities: Every day is different—you could be speaking with CEOs from France, syncing with colleagues in South Africa, and sourcing companies in India, all in one day.
  • Networking: Build your global network by working with founders, C-level decision-makers, and inspiring leaders across various industries.
  • Rapid Growth: Be part of a fast-growing team that’s scaling rapidly to meet the demand for remote internships worldwide.

Who We're Looking For

Your Attributes

We’re looking for a powerful mix of The Self-Starter , The Persuader , and The Global Citizen — rolled into one Placement Matching Specialist. Here’s how you’ll know you’re the right fit:

  • You own the outcome: You don’t wait to be told what to do — you take initiative, navigate ambiguity, and find a way to get results. You’re outcome-obsessed and don’t shift blame. (The Driver )
  • You level up fast: You seek feedback, ask smart questions, and are eager to improve. You don’t need to have all the answers on Day 1 — but you make sure you’re sharper by Day 10. (The Learner )
  • You close the loop: You follow through with precision, push through setbacks, and go beyond the ask. You don’t just complete tasks — you finish strong and make an impact. (The Finisher )
  • You stay cool under pressure: Deadlines, shifting priorities, and high volumes don’t rattle you. You prioritize, adapt, and get it done without dropping the ball.
  • You thrive in a global, remote team: You’re comfortable with tech, culturally aware, and communicative — even across time zones. You know how to stay productive and connected without being micromanaged.

Your Experience

We know that great talent comes from all backgrounds. Ideally, you have:

  • Fluency in English (you don’t need to have an IELTS, but if you did, it would be 7.0+).
  • 1-3 years of experience in recruitment, sales, or similar roles where persuasion is key.
  • Experience working remotely or with global teams.
  • A passion for technology and the ability to quickly learn and navigate new systems.
  • A history of working in fast-paced environments with ambitious goals.
  • Cultural awareness and adaptability, especially if you’ve studied, lived, or worked abroad.
  • Proven ability to hustle, meet targets, and deliver results under pressure.

We’re also keen to hear from career switchers with strong written persuasion skills . Whether you’ve honed these in teaching , customer service , or another fast-paced role, if you:

  • Have a knack for crafting compelling messages
  • Can influence others through your writing
  • Are ready to bring your drive and adaptability into a new challenge

Virtual Internships Perks and Benefits

  • Remote-First: All roles at VI are currently and will remain remote - flexibility to work from anywhere.
  • Flexible Working Hours: Start earlier, leave earlier, take a shorter lunch, or leave later, it's totally up to you.
  • Annual Leave : Wherever you are in the world, you’ll get 25 days of paid annual leave per year, plus bank holidays and 5 sick days.
  • Life Event Leave: There are moments in life where your life responsibility is a higher priority than work (e.g. moving house, your best friend getting married, your sister having a baby) therefore, you’ll get 5 days of paid life-event leave to support these occasions. You also get a day off on your birthday. This is in addition to your Annual Leave.
  • Flexible VIer Budget: You’ll receive a flexible budget of $1,000 per year that you can use on but not limited to your work setup, personal wellness, or professional development.
  • Tech: New joiners receive a budget for your company laptop depending on the role and location.

Equality & Diversity

Virtual Internships is an equal opportunity employer, committed to equality and diversity amongst both our employees and prospective applicants. We ensure all applicants are treated equally and fairly throughout our recruitment process.

Who are we?

ICEYE is the global leader in synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite operations for Earth Observation, persistent monitoring, and natural catastrophe solutions. We own and operate the world's largest SAR constellation. Headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates from five international locations with over 600 employees from nearly 60 countries. Data derived from our SAR images assists customers in making data-driven decisions to address time-critical challenges across sectors such as maritime, disaster management, insurance, and finance.

Our team comprises experts across disciplines like engineering, software development, and radar technology. We are innovative, driven, and strive for excellence. Core values include teamwork, curiosity, and having fun, which help us make the impossible possible!

ICEYE is at the forefront of new technology, continuously building and operating our commercial SAR satellite constellation. We support continuous professional development through courses, training, and conference attendance. At ICEYE, your growth and success are priorities.

description:
Banco de Talentos

Não encontrou uma vaga para você? Cadastre seu currículo aqui e venha fazer parte do nosso Banco de Talentos !

O Banco de Talentos tem o objetivo de criar uma base de candidatos pré-selecionados para oportunidades de emprego futuras. Ao se inscrever nessa vaga, você terá a chance de trabalhar na maior marca de futebol e clube poliesportivo da América Latina!

Não se esqueça de manter os dados do seu currículo sempre atualizados e fique atento(a) às nossas vagas.

Todas as vagas permitem candidaturas para PcD.

Para nós, Diversidade e Inclusão são importantes para a composição de um time vitorioso!

A inscrição em nosso Banco de Talentos não garante a contratação, pois ela dependerá da disponibilidade de vagas e compatibilidade do currículo com os requisitos de cada oportunidade.

Falando sobre o Flamengo...

Que tal trabalhar em um clube de futebol referência em gestão?

Após um árduo trabalho de reestruturação, o Clube de Regatas do Flamengo tornou-se uma das marcas de maior credibilidade no cenário nacional, atraindo grandes parceiros comerciais e investindo pesado em infraestrutura e recursos humanos. Aqui a gente procura os melhores craques para todas as modalidades - inclusive nos setores administrativos! Dos mais jovens talentos com sede de aprendizado aos profissionais mais gabaritados e experientes para gerir nossas equipes, aqui tem espaço para todos, de todas as cores, crenças e gêneros.

Venha ser um dos craques do maior clube poliesportivo do Brasil!

O Flamengo é a maior marca de futebol e o maior clube poliesportivo da América Latina. Conhecido por ter a Maior Torcida do Mundo, com mais de 48 milhões de rubro-negros apaixonados espalhados pelo mundo, foi fundado em 1895 e, desde então, coleciona títulos em diversas modalidades esportivas ao longo de sua história centenária. No futebol, carro-chefe do clube, o Flamengo é octacampeão brasileiro, pentacampeão da Copa do Brasil, maior vencedor do Campeonato Carioca com 39 títulos, tricampeão da Copa Libertadores e campeão mundial de clubes, taças erguidas por grandes craques do futebol que vestiram o Manto Sagrado e, é claro, pela Nação Rubro-Negra, sempre atuante como 12º jogador.

O clube colheu os frutos e os números se transformaram em resultado esportivo, com troféus erguidos pelo futebol e pelos esportes olímpicos, conquistando campeonatos nacionais de remo, basquete, ginástica artística, polo aquático, nado artístico e até mesmo esportes eletrônicos. Nos últimos Jogos Olímpicos, em Tóquio e Paris, o Mais Querido teve diversos representantes e fez bonito com as conquistas históricas das ginastas Rebeca Andrade, Jade Barbosa, Lorrane Oliveira e Flavia Saraiva, do canoísta Isaquias Queiroz e da judoca Rafaela Silva, todos atletas rubro-negros.

Já pensou em poder fazer parte de tudo isso?

Trabalhar no Flamengo é diferente de tudo que você já viveu…

Trabalhar com paixão é mágico e muito especial. Ser um colaborador do Flamengo é ver a história sendo escrita de perto, é ter a emoção como colega de trabalho, é sentir como é gratificante fazer parte de grandes conquistas, é fazer parte de uma família e de uma Nação. Venha trabalhar conosco, participar do presente, construir o futuro e valorizar o passado de uma instituição centenária que mexe com o coração de mais de 48 milhões de apaixonados.

Eternos ídolos já vestiram o Manto Sagrado, grandes craques formam nossas equipes, excelentes profissionais constroem a história de sucesso do Flamengo... O próximo pode ser você!

Todo mundo sabe que quem joga pelo Flamengo tem que honrar o Manto Sagrado! Aqui, valorizamos muito o comprometimento, a dedicação, a superação, a resiliência. Para quem é craque do Mengão, não tem bola perdida: a gente entra firme na dividida e se destaca pelo profissionalismo. A busca é incessante pela excelência!

…AMOR E PAIXÃO!

Pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem e pelo Flamengo! Você verá que é muito fácil ter paixão pelo seu trabalho com a gente. Ética, transparência, honestidade, profissionalismo, respeito e integridade são titulares do nosso time em todas as partidas. Estamos sempre juntos com garra, otimismo e alegria para vencer!

Zelo pelas pessoas, desenvolvimento e constante aperfeiçoamento. Aqui no Flamengo, queremos ensinar, mas também aprender com você! Muitas são as oportunidades de evoluir com o espírito rubro-negro. Somos um time e uma família!

If you're ready for growth, ownership, and impact — apply now and help us redefine B2B finance in Latin America.

Clara's Hybrid Policy

Claridians in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home.   • Experience with SaaS product development (billing, subscriptions, multi-tenancy)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous role as a startup founder or CTO
  • Familiarity with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK)
  • Experience in event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, pub/sub)
  • Knowledge of resilient microservice patterns (circuit breaker, retries)
  • Understanding of application security principles (OWASP, network policies, vulnerability scanning)
  • Contributions to open source projects
  • Exposure to data infrastructure tools such as Airflow or Spark, and/or experience with Data & AI platforms

Overview

We’re looking for a Digital Marketing Specialist (Remote) candidate that reside in Brazil to join the fast-moving global team at High Tide Inc. , one of the largest cannabis and accessories companies in the world. Our brand portfolio includes Smoke Cartel , Grasscity , Daily High Club , Canna Cabana , and others — with e-commerce sites operating across North America and Europe.

This is a high-impact role that blends strategic coordination with hands-on marketing execution. You’ll take the lead in keeping projects on track — ensuring homepage banners, paid ad campaigns, web updates, and loyalty promos are executed seamlessly and on schedule. From leading competitive website research and identifying must-have features from a marketing perspective, to driving loyalty initiatives forward, you’ll be at the center of campaign execution and digital marketing strategy.

If you’re organized, proactive, and detail-oriented — with experience managing timelines, managing paid ad performance, and collaborating cross-functionally — this role will give you the scope to shine and grow within a dynamic team.

Important: While this role is open to applicants across any location in Brazil, High Tide brands do not operate or market in Brazil. This role will support our global markets in North America and Europe.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

  • Coordinate cross-functional marketing campaigns from brief to execution
  • Manage homepage banners and ensure on-site promotions are reflected accurately and on time
  • Work with the design team to proof and QA Figma files before web development hand-off

  • Maintain strong organization and visibility into timelines and team deliverables

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For

  • 3-5 years of experience in digital marketing, ideally in D2C or e-commerce
  • Strong project management skills and cross-functional coordination experience
  • Comfortable managing paid ad campaigns, analyzing performance, and optimizing with support from channel specialists
  • Familiarity with web QA, Figma reviews, and working with development teams
  • Detail-oriented with strong written English and task ownership
  • Able to handle fast turnarounds, shifting priorities, and multiple brand voices
  • Bonus: Experience with Shopify, or marketing automation platforms
  • Bonus: Familiarity with loyalty programs, segmentation strategies, or customer journey mapping

Why Join High Tide

  • Be part of one of the largest global cannabis and accessories companies
  • Work with a portfolio of exciting, category-leading e-commerce brands
  • Join a collaborative, international team that values speed, ownership, and creativity
  • Have visibility into high-level strategy while owning critical execution touchpoints
  • Fully remote role with flexibility and meaningful impact

How to Apply

To apply, please submit:

  • Your resume in English
  • (Optional) Any relevant portfolio or example campaigns that reflect your digital marketing experience

About Us

High Tide Inc. is the leading community-grown, retail-forward cannabis enterprise engineered to unleash the full value of the world’s most powerful plant and is the second-largest cannabis retailer globally by store count⁷ . High Tide (HITI) is uniquely-built around the cannabis consumer, with wholly-diversified and fully-integrated operations across all components of cannabis, including:

  • Bricks & Mortar Retail: Canna Cabana is the largest cannabis retail chain in Canada, with 200 plus current locations spanning British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario and growing. In 2021, Canna Cabana became the first cannabis discount club retailer in the world.

  • E-commerce Platforms : High Tide operates a suite of leading accessory sites across the world, including Grasscity.com, Smokecartel.com, Dailyhighclub.com, and Dankstop.com.

CBD: High Tide continues to cultivate the possibilities of consumer CBD through Nuleafnaturals.com, FABCBD.com, blessedcbd.de and blessedcbd.co.uk.

Wholesale Distribution: High Tide keeps that cannabis category stocked with wholesale solutions via Valiant.

Licensing: High Tide continues to push cannabis culture forward through fresh partnerships and license agreements under the Famous Brandz name.

High Tide consistently moves ahead of the currents, having been named one of Canada’s Top Growing Companies in 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024 by the Globe and Mail’s Report on Business Magazine, and was named as one of the top 10 performing diversified industries stocks in both 2022 and 2024 TSX Venture 50. title: Strategy & Operations Analyst (Growth Campaigns)
description:
Strategy & Operations Analyst (Growth Campaigns)

Rio de Janeiro - Brazil

Operations & Strategy - Food Regular

About the company

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

About the team/role

We are looking for talented professionals to join our Regional Operations team at 99Food ! This is an exciting opportunity for individuals who are highly analytical, data-driven, and eager to solve complex business challenges at the city level. If you have a start-up spirit and are always looking to create value, you would be a great fit for this team!

As part of Regional Operations , selected candidates will play a key role in driving city growth, improving marketplace performance, and shaping local strategies that connect users, restaurants, and couriers. This role requires a hands-on approach, strong problem-solving skills, and a proactive mindset to identify opportunities for growth, efficiency, and differentiation.

The ideal candidates will engage directly with restaurant partners, customers, and business development teams to understand the dynamics of each city. They will analyze local performance data, gather on-the-ground perspectives, and translate insights into actionable strategies that strengthen 99Food’s position in each market and ensure long-term sustainable growth.

In this role, you'll be...

This position will be at the core of city-level growth campaigns at 99Food . You will be responsible for managing the full campaign cycle — from identifying opportunities and improvement areas, to designing and implementing strategies that drive marketplace performance.

Your mission will be to create and execute impactful growth initiatives , ensuring that our campaigns are not only innovative but also measurable and results-oriented. This means working closely with cross-functional teams (BD, Marketing, CRM, Product, and Operations) to bring strategies to life, monitor performance, and iterate quickly to capture new opportunities.

You will also play a key role in scaling successful campaigns across cities, ensuring best practices are shared and local nuances are respected. This role demands a data-driven mindset, strategic thinking, and a strong bias for action to turn insights into concrete results that accelerate 99Food’s expansion and reinforce our presence in each market.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

  • General Requirements
    • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Statistics, Business Administration, Economics, or related fields.
  • 2–5 years of experience in data analytics, operations, strategy, or growth-related roles.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Advanced Excel, SQL, and data analytics skills (Python/R knowledge is a plus, but not required).
  • Growth & Customer Expertise
  • Prior experience with customer-related activities (e.g., campaign management, communication strategy, customer cohort analysis, market analysis, budget management, etc.).
  • Experience with creative asset creation (CRM, ads agency, digital campaigns, etc.).
  • Stakeholder and project management experience, with exposure to Operations, Product, Sales/BD, and Marketing/CRM.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; Mandarin is a strong plus.

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non-negotiable value of who we are.

We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. Collaboration with HRBPs and Business Leaders

  • Partner with HRBPs to integrate workforce planning into talent, succession, and organizational design strategies.

Advanced Analytics & Workforce Insights

Talent Strategy & Future of Work

  • Identify emerging workforce gaps and design strategies for talent acquisition, reskilling, and retention.

Operational Excellence & Governance

  • Oversee workforce planning tools and ensure consistent, high-quality data inputs across the enterprise.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Sobre nossa história...

Desde o século XIX, a Granado encanta gerações com produtos de qualidade e sustentabilidade. Fundada há mais de 150 anos, mantém valores sólidos e inovação.

A Perfumaria Phebo , fundada em 1930 em Belém do Pará, é reconhecida por fragrâncias marcantes e alta qualidade, consolidando-se como uma marca de luxo e excelência olfativa.

Recentemente, a CARE uniu-se à Granado e Phebo para oferecer experiências de autocuidado que unem ciência, tecnologia e sustentabilidade.

Nossa história centenária constrói um futuro inovador, presente em cada produto, loja, embalagem e no compromisso com o bem-estar, segurança e meio ambiente.

Juntas, Granado, Phebo e CARE representam a harmonia entre tradição e inovação, convidando nossos clientes a jornadas de bem-estar e beleza responsável.

Job description

É uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida.

A unidade de saúde está preparada para o atendimento às mais diversas patologias do universo oftalmológico para a população da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, tais como:

·diagnóstico e tratamento dos distúrbios da motilidade ocular, visão binocular e anomalias associadas;

·realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação.

Coordenar a fim de garantir o cumprimento de normas, rotinas, regulamentações da Instituição e, das atividades planejadas para assistência, participando, analisando e avaliando os processos e as interfaces com a equipe para promover uma assistência segura e de qualidade. title: Experienced Recruiter For The Swedish It Industry
description:
Overview

Experienced Recruiter For The Swedish IT Industry — role at Nexer Telescope

Join to apply for the Experienced Recruiter For The Swedish IT Industry role at Nexer Telescope.

Sweden needs skilled engineers! About 30 000 of them by 2030, according to the Swedish Statistical Central Bureau. Right now we have ~200 open positions for Software Engineers with our clients in Sweden. Are you ready to help us?

Job description

As a senior headhunter you will help us to find engineers who are ready to embark on an adventure to Sweden. Living standards in Sweden are high by international comparisons, and we need a lot of engineers. Your job will be to find them and inform them about all the benefits of living and working in Sweden. To move to another country is often one of the biggest leaps in life, so a lot of your job will be to build trust with suitable candidates. Supporting you in these tasks, you will have the assistance of a competent global team of recruiters, as well as an executive management team in Sweden. In addition you will be supported by our Swedish delivery management team that handles all practical matters related to relocation to Sweden for our consultants. In short we fix everything for our employees - visa, work permits, tickets, housing, you name it - we fix it! Our clients are primarily within the fields of software development, R&D, cyber security, automotive, embedded systems, telecommunications, online solutions and application development. Your work will be planned and executed together with your colleagues in Albania, Argentina, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Brazil, Colombia, Hungary, Kenya, North Macedonia, Sweden, Turkey, Ukraine, Venezuela and Vietnam. You will be part of an efficient team characterized by a profound joy for having the opportunity to help engineers and their families to build a new career and life in Sweden. Telescope\'s core values are joy, trust, and professionalism.

Responsibilities

  • Find engineers who are ready to relocate to Sweden.
  • Inform candidates about benefits of living and working in Sweden and build trust through the recruitment process.
  • Coordinate with a global team of recruiters and Sweden-based management to support relocation logistics.
  • Collaborate with clients in software development, R&D, cyber security, automotive, embedded systems, telecommunications, online solutions and application development.
  • Plan and execute recruiting activities with colleagues across multiple countries.

Required competence

At least 5 years of professional experience from recruitment in the IT sector, or similar technical experience.

  • A solid and well proven network of local engineering talent within IT.
  • Extremely service oriented, with a flexible mindset towards always finding the best solution for the challenge at hand.
  • High quality and brand awareness.
  • Understanding or interest in headhunting and the principle of IT outstaffing/outsourcing companies.
  • Upper intermediate English.
  • Some knowledge of at least a handful of contemporary IT technologies and methods, as well as the ability to learn the main ideas of new technologies.
  • Analytical, well organized with an eye for details, with the ability to identify and close a recruitment request.
  • Self confident, happy, social, friendly and outgoing with a high level of self motivation.
  • Durable and stubborn, with the capacity to take a "+no" as a reason to try harder.
  • Passionate about success, with an executive yet relaxed attitude towards work, colleagues and customers.
  • Responsive and responsible, with an appropriate and representative appearance.

Details

  • Extent & Duration: Start ASAP.
  • Full time. Long term contract as a Private Entrepreneur. Minimum 12 months.
  • Eight hours of efficient work per day, Monday to Friday. Overtime compensation 1:1 in flex.
  • Location: You will be working from home or from a co-location center of your choice.
  • Economy: Remuneration starting at 1200 USD, plus remittance fees and taxes.
  • Free national holidays, with maintained payment. 20 paid vacation days. Paid travels, housing, and per diem.

Overview

Experienced Recruiter For The Swedish IT Industry – Nexer Telescope

Join to apply for the Experienced Recruiter For The Swedish IT Industry role at Nexer Telescope .

Sweden needs skilled engineers. About 30 000 of them by 2030, according to the Swedish Statistical Central Bureau. We currently have ~200 open positions for Software Engineers with our clients in Sweden. Are you ready to help us?

Job Description: As a senior headhunter you will help us to find engineers who are ready to embark on an adventure to Sweden. Living standards in Sweden are high by international comparisons, and we need a lot of engineers. Your job will be to find them and inform them about all the benefits of living and working in Sweden. To move to another country is often one of the biggest leaps in life, so a lot of your job will be to build trust with suitable candidates. You will be supported by a global team of recruiters, as well as an executive management team in Sweden. You will also be supported by our Swedish delivery management team that handles relocation-related practical matters for our consultants. In short, we fix everything for our employees – visa, work permits, tickets, housing, you name it.

Our clients are primarily within the fields of software development, R&D, cyber security, automotive, embedded systems, telecommunications, online solutions and application development. Your work will be planned and executed together with colleagues in Albania, Argentina, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Brazil, Colombia, Hungary, Kenya, North Macedonia, Sweden, Turkey, Ukraine, Venezuela and Vietnam. You will be part of an efficient team with a clear focus on helping engineers and their families build a new career and life in Sweden. Telescope’s core values are joy, trust, and professionalism.

Responsibilities

  • Find engineers who are ready to relocate to Sweden and inform them about the benefits of living and working there.
  • Build trust with suitable candidates to facilitate relocation and hiring.
  • Collaborate with a global team of recruiters and the Swedish delivery management team to handle relocation logistics.
  • Coordinate with clients across software development, R&D, cyber security, automotive, embedded systems, telecommunications, online solutions and application development.

Qualifications

  • At least 5 years of professional experience in recruitment in the IT sector, or similar technical experience.
  • A solid and well-proven network of local engineering talent within IT.
  • Extremely service-oriented with a flexible mindset to find the best solution.
  • High quality and brand awareness.
  • Understanding or interest in headhunting and IT outstaffing/outsourcing.
  • Upper intermediate English.
  • Knowledge of contemporary IT technologies and the ability to learn new technologies.
  • Analytical, well-organized with attention to detail, and able to identify and close a recruitment request.
  • Self-confident, social, friendly, and highly motivated.
  • Resilient and persistent, able to view a “no” as a reason to try harder.
  • Passionate about success with an executive yet relaxed attitude toward work, colleagues, and customers.
  • Responsive and responsible with a professional appearance.

Job Details

  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Full-time
  • Job function: Human Resources

Extent & Duration: Start ASAP. Full-time. Long term contract as a Private Entrepreneur. Minimum 12 months. Eight hours of efficient work per day, Monday to Friday. Overtime compensation 1:1 in flex.

Location: Remote or from a co-location center of your choice.

Economy: Remuneration starting at 1200 USD, plus remittance fees and taxes. Free national holidays with maintained payment. 20 paid vacation days. Paid travels, housing, and per diem.

Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 20,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

About Us: At TechnipFMC, within the Controls & Automation product line, we are pioneering technology platforms for the electrification of Subsea Control Systems and the advancement of renewable energy sources such as offshore wind, hydrogen, and wave energy.

Our Team : The Electronics R&D team works across a broad spectrum of technologies, including analog electronics, FPGA, SoC, power design, safety design, motor controllers, processor design, and power line modems. These technologies are integral to various control system applications.

Your Role: As part of the Controls & Automation team at TechnipFMC, you will engage in the design, development, qualification, system integration, and production of new products into commissioning and field operation. Our multidisciplinary development environment includes HW, SW, system, test, mechatronics, and production engineering teams working collaboratively.

We are seeking Senior Embedded Hardware Developers with expertise in embedded systems and hardware design to join our Hardware development team.

Job Description

  • Define hardware requirements in collaboration with system architects, SW architects, product owners
  • Design and develop embedded hardware circuits, PCBAs, FPGA modules, including component selection, schematic drawing, PCB layout, and prototype building.
  • Conduct functional verification of embedded hardware circuits, PCBAs, FPGA modules, electronic sub-assemblies.
  • Collaborate with systems architects, mechanical designers, PCB layout, manufacturing, reliability, and SW engineering teams to design and develop embedded hardware products.
  • Create test and verification procedures and write test reports on functional, environmental, system operation mode, and manufacturing testing of custom embedded hardware designs.

You are meant for this job if:

  • Extended understanding of Central Processing Units, microcontrollers, embedded software and signal processing techniques
  • Advanced knowledge of VHDL and FPGA design and verification methodologies.
  • Experience of LT SPICE, MATLAB, Simulink, Python, and Intel (Altera) Quartus
  • Knowledge of C, C++, assembly language or other embedded software languages
  • Schematic design and PCB layout using ECAD tools like Altium Designer or equivalent.
  • Experience with lab instruments such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, network analyzers, communication analyzers, signal generators, and simulators.
  • Expertise in PCB layout for optimal component placement, reduced stray inductance/capacitance, improved manufacturability, and EMC compliance.
  • Experience in embedded hardware design optimized for DFX requirements (manufacturability and testability).
  • Understanding of EMC requirements and CE certification relevant to embedded controller design in control system applications.
  • Knowledge and experience of safety and reliability standards including IEC61508

Qualifications:

  • BSc, MSc, or PhD in electronics, automation, cybernetics, or a related engineering field.
  • 3-5 years of industrial experience in relevant embedded hardware development and industrialization.
  • Ability to approach complex problems structurally.
  • Open-minded, professional English proficiency, and adaptability to work in a multicultural environment.
  • Continuously raising standards, innovative, and solution oriented.
  • Interest in electronics is an additional advantage.

What We Offer:

  • Engaging tasks and work-life balance.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Training and career development opportunities.
  • Comprehensive insurance and pension plans.

Experienced Recruiter For The Swedish It Industry

Join to apply for the Experienced Recruiter For The Swedish It Industry role at Nexer Telescope.

Sweden needs skilled engineers! About 30 000 of them by 2030 to be precise, according to the Swedish Statistical Central Bureau. Right now we have approximately 200 open positions for Software Engineers with our clients in Sweden. Are you ready to help us?

Job Description

As a senior headhunter you will help us to find engineers who are ready to embark on an adventure to Sweden. Living standards in Sweden are great by international comparisons, and we need a lot of engineers. Your job will be to find them and inform them about all the benefits of living and working in Sweden. To move to another country is often one of the biggest leaps in life, so a lot of your job will be to build trust with suitable candidates. Supporting you in these tasks, you will have the assistance of a competent global team of recruiters, as well as an executive management team in Sweden. In addition you will be supported by our Swedish delivery management team that handles all practical matters related to the relocation to Sweden for our consultants. In short we fix everything for our employees - visa, work permits, tickets, arrangement of housing, you name it - we fix it! Our clients are primarily within the fields of software development, R&D, cyber security, automotive, embedded systems, telecommunications, online solutions and application development. Your work will be planned and executed together with your colleagues in Albania, Argentina, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Brazil, Colombia, Hungary, Kenya, North Macedonia, Sweden, Turkey, Ukraine, Venezuela and Vietnam. You will be part of an efficient team characterized by a profound joy for having the opportunity to be able to help engineers and their families to build a new career and life in Sweden. Telescope's core values are joy, trust, and professionalism.

Required competence

title: Senior maintenance engineer rotating equipment
description:
Overview

As a Senior Maintenance Engineer, you will collaborate closely with the clients Maintenance Engineering, Planning, and Offshore Operations teams, as well as Shapes remote specialists, to implement and optimize data-driven maintenance strategies for critical rotating equipment in the Oil & Gas sector. Your role will focus on condition monitoring, technical data analysis, and providing actionable recommendations to enhance equipment reliability, availability, and operational performance.

We are looking for a technically skilled professional with strong experience in predictive maintenance and rotating machinery diagnostics, capable of working across multidisciplinary teams to support continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze inspection and test data, focusing on vibration analysis (including spectra) and lubricant analysis to detect early signs of equipment failure.
  • Diagnose equipment condition and recommend corrective and predictive maintenance actions.
  • Create work notifications and service orders (WO/Notification) in CMMS to ensure accurate execution of maintenance activities.
  • Evaluate intervention effectiveness by analyzing results and calculating avoided costs.
  • Develop technical reports and performance indicators related to equipment and maintenance strategy.
  • Maintain and update technical case studies in Shape Lighthouse, ensuring traceability and knowledge retention.
  • Collaborate integrally with offshore teams, client engineering and planning, and Shapes remote specialists.
  • Support continuous development and enhancement of predictive maintenance strategies.
  • Ensure operational integrity, safety, and compliance with industry standards.

Requirements

  • Bachelors degree in Mechanical, Mechatronics, or related fields.
  • Proven experience in predictive maintenance, reliability, and diagnostics of rotating equipment (compressors, pumps, turbomachinery, etc.).
  • Advanced skills in vibration analysis, spectra interpretation, and condition monitoring data.
  • Knowledge of lubricant analysis and interpretation of physicochemical and particulate parameters.
  • Familiarity with maintenance management systems such as SAP PM, Maximo, or equivalents.
  • Experience with asset monitoring systems like OSIsoft PI, SCADA, or similar.
  • Understanding of predictive, prescriptive, and condition-based maintenance strategies.
  • Desirable certifications in vibration analysis (ISO CAT II or higher) and lubricant analysis.

Differentials

  • Previous experience in offshore environments (FPSOs, platforms, refineries, etc.).
  • Knowledge of industry standards such as API, ISO, NR-13.
  • Experience with failure analysis methodologies (FMEA, RCA, RCM).
  • Intermediate to advanced technical English.

  • Day off in Your Birthday Month: A day off in your birthday month to celebrate in any way you prefer
  • Extended Maternity/Paternity Leave: So you can enjoy this important time with your family, with peace of mind that your professional life will remain well-supported.

title: Senior Product Data Analyst
description:
This range is provided by LawnStarter. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more.

Base pay range

$60,000.00/yr - $70,000.00/yr

As a Sr. Product Data Analyst, you'll be directly impacting our results through insights and reports. You'll be working close to product managers, researchers, and other business stakeholders, helping with prioritization, assessments, and business recommendations. It will be your responsibility, alongside the Analytics team, to nurture the data-driven culture within the company, making data easier to consume, be it through interactive reports, easy-to-use datasets, documentation, training.

Help Us Build the Future of Outdoor Services

At LawnStarter, we are transforming the $100B+ outdoor home services industry—making it easier for homeowners to book, manage, and enjoy services like lawn care, landscaping, and more. With $30M+ in venture funding and solid traction, we are investing in the next generation of our platform—and we are looking for a Senior Product Data Analyst to help drive it.

See what we are building!

Problems to be solved

Your primary responsibility will be to empower our organization to be more data-driven, with multiple avenues to accomplish that, such as:

  • Modeling & Analysis: A marketplace is a complex system with various moving parts and often conflicting signals. This creates opportunities to identify gaps, insights, or optimizations. The analyses and models may range from simple AB tests to multivariate models on retention or ETA. You should have advanced experience in SQL and intermediate experience in Python or R.
  • Reporting: A complex system creates many metrics to track for running the business efficiently. You will work with teams to understand their needs and help the Analytics team create and maintain a reliable, user-friendly reporting system, primarily using Tableau and Metabase.
  • Analytics Engineering: Occasionally you will work on the inner layers of our Data Warehouse to provide clean and documented datasets for reports and end users. Understanding business needs and translating them into our DW is crucial; we use DBT for data transformation, so SQL experience is a must.

Requirements

  • Experience: 4+ years in data & analytics at data-driven companies
  • Education: STEM or business background or relevant education that enables you to empower the organization to be more data-driven
  • Learning Mindset: You take pride in understanding problems deeply, asking the right questions, and approaching problems with structure and logic. You adapt to the business as needed rather than applying a fixed process blindly.
  • Team player: You collaborate effectively with others and create an environment where people are excited to work with you, with intellectual honesty and trust
  • Business focus: You understand how your analysis connects with product, customers, and financials, and can drill down metrics from top to bottom as needed
  • Bias for action: You balance careful analysis with getting things done, avoiding unnecessary perfectionism or rigid full-solution builds before validating with real use

VERY IMPORTANT REMINDER: Please upload your English resume—applications without it will not be considered.

Benefits

  • Salary range: $60-$70k USD annually
  • Work from anywhere
  • Flexible hours—complete work on your schedule
  • Unlimited PTO — Focus on results. Take time you need to recharge or work hard when you return

LawnStarter is building the future of outdoor home services. Want to help us shape it?
Apply now and let's grow together.

Overview

Experienced Recruiter For The Swedish It Industry role at Nexer Telescope . Sweden needs skilled engineers! About 30 000 of them by 2030, according to the Swedish Statistical Central Bureau. Right now we have ~200 open positions for Software Engineers with our clients in Sweden. Are you ready to help us?

As a senior headhunter you will help us to find engineers who are ready to embark on an adventure to Sweden. Living standards in Sweden are great by any international comparisons, and we need a lot of engineers. Your job will be to find them and inform them about all the benefits of living and working in Sweden. To move to another country is often one of the biggest leaps in life, so a lot of your job will be to build trust with suitable candidates. Supporting you in these tasks, you will have the assistance of a competent global team of recruiters, as well as an executive management team in Sweden. In addition you will be supported by our Swedish delivery management team that handles all practical matters related to the relocation to Sweden for our consultants. In short we fix everything for our employees - visa, work permits, tickets, arrangement of housing, you name it - we fix it!

Our clients are primarily within the fields of software development, R&D, cyber security, automotive, embedded systems, telecommunications, online solutions and application development. Your work will be planned and executed together with your colleagues in Albania, Argentina, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Brazil, Colombia, Hungary, Kenya, North Macedonia, Sweden, Turkey, Ukraine, Venezuela and Vietnam. You will be part of an efficient team characterized by a profound joy for having the opportunity to be able to help engineers and their families to build a new career and life in Sweden. Telescope's core values are joy, trust, and professionalism!

Responsibilities

  • Identify and engage engineers suitable for relocation to Sweden, and communicate the benefits of living and working there.
  • Build trust with candidates who are considering a move to a new country.
  • Coordinate with a global team of recruiters and the Swedish delivery management team for relocation logistics.
  • Assist with visa, work permits, tickets, housing arrangements and other practical relocation steps.
  • Collaborate with clients across software development, R&D, cyber security, automotive, embedded systems, telecommunications, online solutions and application development.
  • Plan and execute recruitment activities with colleagues in multiple countries.

description:
Overview

Rain is the fastest-growing earned wage access (EWA) fintech in the U.S., serving 3.5 million employees and backed by top investors. We are seeking a skilled and driven Senior Application Security Engineer to join Rain's growing Security team. This role is technically grounded and focuses on secure software development and cloud-native defense. You will partner closely with engineering and development squads, and work alongside the Cloud Security and GRC teams to improve Rain's application and platform security posture. The position involves direct engagement in application-layer matters and security reviews, along with contributing to cloud security automation, awareness initiatives, and secure engineering practices across the SDLC.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with development squads to validate vulnerabilities and provide actionable remediation guidance aligned with business risk.
  • Drive threat modeling sessions (e.g., STRIDE, PASTA) for critical systems and APIs.
  • Design, implement, and oversee automated processes for securely updating application and code dependencies, proactively mitigating issues and ensuring timely vulnerability remediation.
  • Integrate security checks into CI/CD pipelines (SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC), working with tools like Semgrep, Snyk, Trivy, and Burp Suite.
  • Contribute to runtime security initiatives, such as container/Kubernetes hardening, RASP, and eBPF-based detection.
  • Build and maintain a security issues dashboard to track remediation status and metrics.
  • Provide real-time support in the event of cybersecurity incidents impacting applications or cloud infrastructure.
  • Partner with the Cloud Security team on security automation tasks and monitoring improvements (e.g., Security Hub remediation automations, DLP monitoring).
  • Conduct proactive research on new threats, vulnerabilities, and attack techniques relevant to Rain's architecture.
  • Collaborate with the GRC team to develop and deliver internal security awareness initiatives, phishing campaigns, and developer training (e.g., secure coding, API security).
  • Participate in continuous improvement of AppSec maturity (e.g., OWASP SAMM, ISO 27001, SOC 2 frameworks).

Required Qualifications

  • Fluent English with strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset; ability to convey security risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing, and/or secure code development, including work with QA teams.
  • Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, and SCA tools (e.g., Semgrep, Burp, Snyk).
  • Deep understanding of web, mobile, and API vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, API Top 10, MITRE CWE).
  • Experience performing code reviews or security assessments and writing clear reports.
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language (e.g., Go, Python, Node.js) and understanding of React/React Native front-ends.
  • Familiarity with secure microservices architectures, event-driven systems, and REST APIs using OAuth2/OpenID Connect.
  • Experience securing CI/CD pipelines and integrating AppSec tooling into SDLC.
  • Solid knowledge of containerization and Kubernetes security fundamentals.
  • Understanding of cloud security (preferably AWS), including IAM, cloud-native service configurations, and network segmentation.
  • Comfortable with Agile development methodologies and cross-functional squads.
  • Software supply chain security (e.g., SBOM, artifact signing).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, GWAPT, CPTE, or CSSLP.
  • AWS, GCP, or Azure Security Specialty certification.
  • Experience with bug bounty triage and vulnerability management platforms (e.g., DefectDojo).
  • Experience implementing RASP or eBPF runtime protection tools.
  • Exposure to LLM/AI security considerations and secure code generation practices.
  • Familiarity with logging and monitoring tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana).

Rain is a diverse team united by a mission to transform payments and financial well-being. We value diversity across our global team and encourage personal and professional growth. We strive to act with data-driven urgency while adapting to challenges daily.
